Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning preferential hiring of veterans by the marine division of the department of transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the preferential hiring of veterans by themarine division of the department of transportation; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) To the greatest extent practicable and within availableresources, the marine division of the department shall expand existingopportunities and develop new opportunities to provide for thepreferential hiring of veterans. Options may include, but are notlimited to, negotiating more preference points for veterans, expandingthe job classes veteran points are used in, notifying veteranassistance organizations of relevant job vacancies, and participatingin the wounded combat veterans internship program. For the purposes ofthis section, "veteran" has the same meaning as in RCW 41.04.005. (2) The department may adopt rules as necessary to implement therequirements of this section.
